ch40-open.title: Manage projects
ch40-open.standfirst: The project browser on your dashboard — finding, grouping and opening the projects you belong to. Full administration lives in the Project management part.

ch19-find.heading: Open the Manage projects page
steps: In the left sidebar, look below My meetings and Invited / Upcoming for the Manage projects item (folder-kanban icon).
Click it. The middle column switches to the project management page, titled Manage projects.
At the top sits a Search projects… box, a grid/list View toggle, and a New project button.
Projects are grouped: My projects (folders you belong to) and Invited (folders another department invited you into for one meeting), each with a count.
Click any project tile or row to drill into its detail. Click All projects to come back to the list.
ch19-find.outcome: You're on the dedicated admin surface. The grid (card) view is the default — covers carry the page; the list view is a denser alternative.
ch19-find.note: The toolbar (search + view toggle + New project) hides entirely when you have no projects yet — the empty state carries its own create button instead.
ch19-find.figcap: The Manage projects page: search, view toggle, and grouped project tiles.

ch19-states.heading: What the list shows

tiles.cap: Folders you belong to, sorted by most recently updated, under the My projects (n) heading. Tiles show cover, name, stage pill and a code · client · location meta line.
Folders another department invited you into for one meeting, under Invited (n), each badged Invited. These open read-only — no admin.
A folder-kanban illustration with “No projects yet” and the hint “Create your first project to start organizing meetings.”, plus a New project button.

ch19-states.useWhen: When a search matches nothing you'll instead see “No projects match "{q}"” with a Clear search link. If the list itself fails to load, it reads “Couldn't load — check your network connection.” with a Retry button.
